test_cases.name: Splash Screen Rendering
test_cases.purpose: Verify splash screen loads, visual logo scales correctly, and no crash occurs on boot.
test_cases.preconditions: Application is uninstalled or cache cleared.
test_cases.expected: Splash screen renders successfully and transitions cleanly to auth options.

test_cases.name: Keyboard Focus Viewports
test_cases.purpose: Verify inputs focus cleanly and keyboard does not obscure target text entries.
test_cases.preconditions: App is loaded on the login screen.
steps: Verify form fields translate upward correctly.
test_cases.expected: Keyboard slides open without overlapping active form elements.

test_cases.name: Root Layout Navigation Guard
test_cases.purpose: Verify deep links or layout redirects protect unauthorized users.
test_cases.expected: Application redirects user to unauthorized notification gate or login route.

test_cases.name: Authentication Login
test_cases.purpose: Verify student and admin user accounts login successfully using standard inputs.
test_cases.preconditions: Target user document status is approved.
test_cases.expected: Authenticates session, loads Firestore user document, and displays courses dashboard.

test_cases.name: User Registration / Signup
test_cases.purpose: Verify registration saves account records in pending status and stores referral logs.
test_cases.expected: Stores document in users collection with status pending, and locks route to onboarding check.

test_cases.name: Forgot Password Lifecycle
test_cases.purpose: Verify recovery reset emails are generated and sent successfully to matching inputs.
test_cases.expected: Fires Firebase Auth sendPasswordResetEmail API and renders check-email message.

test_cases.name: Dashboard Screen Render
test_cases.purpose: Verify tabs, Islamic status widgets, and quick action components render correctly.
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and approved.
steps: Observe Islamic Hadith and Prayer times widgets.
test_cases.expected: All UI grids, Hadith lines, and Salah widgets load without layout shifting.

test_cases.name: Course Lessons List
test_cases.purpose: Verify registered courses display modules, lessons, and progress stats accurately.
test_cases.expected: Renders lessons list with correct locks and progress percentages.

test_cases.name: Lesson Detail View & Audio Player
test_cases.purpose: Verify lesson audio files stream, play, pause, and track progress.
test_cases.expected: Audio stream buffers and begins playing; progress updates are recorded locally.

test_cases.name: Quiz Submission
test_cases.purpose: Verify server-side quiz grading evaluates scores and blocks duplicate submissions.
test_cases.preconditions: Active quiz is open with remaining attempts.
steps: Submit quiz answers before attempt lock expires.
test_cases.expected: Grades quiz authoritatively on server, saves results, and blocks duplicate attempts.

test_cases.name: Payment Submission
test_cases.purpose: Verify student transaction submissions transition state to processing and update logs.
test_cases.expected: Creates transaction record, shifts state to processing, and enqueues verification task.

test_cases.name: Certificate Generation
test_cases.purpose: Verify PDF certificate generation loads in web viewer and download link operates.
test_cases.preconditions: Student completed course with passing grades.
test_cases.expected: Generates personalized certificate document and renders in PDF reader.

test_cases.name: Notification Inbox
test_cases.purpose: Verify received push notifications render in notification screen list.
test_cases.preconditions: Notifications have been dispatched to user's registered tokens.
test_cases.expected: Renders list of updates and redirects user to target deep link path.

test_cases.name: Profile Details Update
test_cases.purpose: Verify custom avatars and profiles update without modifying locked attributes.
test_cases.expected: Firestore profile fields update while role and status variables remain locked.

test_cases.name: Settings Configurations
test_cases.purpose: Verify theme changes, diagnostics check, and app settings operate.
test_cases.expected: UI switches theme dynamically and diagnostics checks return healthy status.

test_cases.name: Account Logout
test_cases.purpose: Verify session tokens are cleared and user is redirected back to login screen.
test_cases.expected: Invalidates auth state, clears local caches, and redirects user to login view.

test_cases.name: Offline Mode Caching
test_cases.purpose: Verify offline caching loads profile information and lessons without network access.
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated and has cached data.
test_cases.expected: Renders profile info and offline-capable lesson contents from local AsyncStorage.

test_cases.name: Background State Resume
test_cases.purpose: Verify app recovers active session and media playback after background pause.
test_cases.expected: Restores audio session and returns screen to the previous interactive state.
